subject: MAP: VPC onramp — staged-commit, credits & platform fee triggers
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@clockwork.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: VPC onramp MAP & licensing — draft timeline

Nikhil / Lauren / Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — team loved the latency profiling. We put together an internal checklist and want to align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties our evaluation gates to commercial milestones. High level we need:

- Pilot acceptance criteria (perf & SLOs)
- Commit ramp schedule (0–12 months)
- Pricing bands and discount triggers tied to commit gates
- Platform fee treatment for on-prem/VPC and any trial credits

I attached a thin draft of our MAP (CLK-MAP-draft-20260802.pdf) — it’s rough, but shows the gates we care about. Can Redwood propose how platform fee credits and SLA exceptions could be staged as we move through the evaluation? Also, what carve-outs exist for an air-gapped on-prem deployment?

Target: sign MAP and SOW by end of September to hit Q4 pilot. Can we get an updated commercial skeleton by Wednesday?

Appreciate the quick turn — happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

Thanks,
Amelia Torres
Head of Platform Engineering
Clockwork Analytics

Attachment: CLK-MAP-draft-20260802.pdf (application/pdf, 56 KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@clockwork.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: VPC onramp MAP & licensing — draft timeline

Amelia —

Thanks for the MAP draft and the clear target dates. We can absolutely line up a staged commercial skeleton that maps discounts / credits to the gates you listed. Quick preview of how we typically structure this for VPC/on‑prem:

1) Pilot (0–2 months): evaluation license, full platform fee waived for pilot nodes; limited token/throughput credits to cover profiling.
2) Early commit (month 3–6): reserved capacity commit for X GPUs/month; platform fee reduced by 50% for committed capacity; small onboarding credit applied on first invoice.
3) Ramp (month 6–12): staircase discounts tied to cumulative committed spend; platform fee steps back to standard but can be offset by a multi‑year commit credit.

We’ll prepare a clean MAP that attaches specific commit thresholds to discount bands and SLA exceptions for on‑prem (e.g., extended support windows and on‑site response SLAs). I’ll circulate a commercial spreadsheet by Wednesday.

Looping in Priyom (cc) to capture the exact commit bands and Lauren for any exception approvals.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: VPC onramp MAP & licensing — draft timeline

Amelia —

Attached is the commercial skeleton I promised (Redwood-Platform-Fee-Options-20260803.xlsx). Summary highlights:

- Commit bands (monthly commit equivalent):
  • Band A: $0–$50k/month — platform fee standard (no discount)
  • Band B: $50–$150k/month — 20% platform fee credit at month 3 commit
  • Band C: >$150k/month — 40% platform fee credit and priority capacity

- Pilot credit: up to $25k of platform fee credit applied to first two months (requires MAP sign)
- SLA exceptions: waivable for pilot phase; longer term SLA exceptions require documented runbook and support retainer (see SLA-exception-request.docx)
- On‑prem air‑gap: licensing is perpetual per-server with an annual platform fee. We can provide temporary trial keys and an audit log export for SOC evidence.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm which Band you expect to land in by the end of pilot.
2) We'll lock in a provisional SOW and DocuSign link for MAP + SOW.
3) After MAP sign, pilot credits applied and trial keys issued.

I’m available for a 30m call tomorrow if you want to walk the spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Platform-Fee-Options-20260803.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22 KB); SLA-exception-request.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 14 KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@clockwork.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: VPC onramp MAP & licensing — draft timeline

Amelia —

Appreciate the clarity on timing. Two clarifications from our side before we ship a final MAP:

- Platform fee waiver during pilot: we can waive platform fee for up to 8 pilot nodes for 60 days. Any more than that will be evaluated case‑by‑case.
- SLA exceptions: we can provide an elevated response SLA for the pilot, but sustained SLA deltas must be tied to a support retainer or a commit band (Band C).

On discounts: we are comfortable with a staircase approach but will need a mid‑pilot checkpoint (perf & cost review) that can trigger the Band B discount. Please include a list of tests/acceptance metrics in the MAP (latency p95, throughput, token cost per inference).

We will prep a redlineable MAP + SOW (including DocuSign link) and aim to have it to you by Thursday EOD.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference
